entities.summary: Kazumi Takayama  is a Japanese tarento, television presenter and novelist. She is a former first generation member of the Japanese idol group Nogizaka46, a co-author of the self-help book Investment Methods that Keep My Money Growing Even Though I'm An Idol, and author of the novel Trapezium.
